CREATE TABLE report_revisions (id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id), company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), version INTEGER NOT NULL, actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, source_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, pdf_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL, pdf_bytes BYTEA NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_report_revision_version UNIQUE (job_id, version))
CREATE FUNCTION feniq_report_revision_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Report revisions are immutable'; END $$
CREATE TRIGGER report_revisions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON report_revisions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION feniq_report_revision_immutable()
